QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_65

question.text: Under SAS-1300 a common ATTRIBUTION challenge is:

answer.text: Differentiating impact of the E-Diksha project from broader RBI / Jan Dhan / UPI expansion trends (the case explicitly lists this as a limitation)

explanation.text: The Logic: The E-Diksha case explicitly lists as a limitation: 'Differentiating impact created by E-Diksha project and other Government and Non-Government efforts towards financial inclusion'. SAS-1300 requires the SIA to isolate SE contribution from the broader financial-inclusion tidal wave. The Trap: Options B, C, A are tangential. Cross-Exam Context: Trend-vs-treatment separation also in XV Research Analyst (market-vs-alpha) and X-A / X-B (Investment Adviser).
